"""Bounded CPython-only diagnostic stress; no project or ctypes imports.

Independently constructed code-metadata churn, informed by CPython issue 158200.
The parent enforces a 30-second child limit. Output intentionally uses only the
standard interpreter's fatal handler; repetitive diagnostic output goes to NUL.
"""
import faulthandler
import json
import os
import sys
import threading
import time
import types

assert sys.version_info[:3] == (3, 12, 12), sys.version
assert "ctypes" not in sys.modules
assert not any(name.startswith(("maverick", "lightwork")) for name in sys.modules)


def seed(argument):
    return argument + 1


closing = threading.Event()
counter = [0]


def churn():
    index = 0
    while not closing.is_set():
        dynamic = seed.__code__.replace(
            co_filename="synthetic_frame_" + str(index) + ".py",
            co_name="synthetic_function_" + str(index),
        )
        action = types.FunctionType(dynamic, {})
        assert action(7) == 8
        del action, dynamic
        index += 1
    counter[0] = index


timed = sys.argv[1] == "timed"
duration = 8.0
print(json.dumps({"event": "start", "version": sys.version, "timed": timed,
                  "seconds": duration, "ctypes_loaded": False, "project_imports": False}), flush=True)
faulthandler.enable(all_threads=True)
thread = threading.Thread(target=churn)
thread.start()
with open(os.devnull, "w", encoding="ascii") as sink:
    if timed:
        faulthandler.dump_traceback_later(0.000001, repeat=True, file=sink)
    try:
        time.sleep(duration)
    finally:
        if timed:
            faulthandler.cancel_dump_traceback_later()
        closing.set()
        thread.join(2.0)
assert not thread.is_alive()
assert "ctypes" not in sys.modules
assert not any(name.startswith(("maverick", "lightwork")) for name in sys.modules)
print(json.dumps({"event": "completed", "calls": counter[0], "timed": timed,
                  "ctypes_loaded": False, "project_imports": False}), flush=True)
controller_source:
"""Run at most three bounded CPython-only child attempts, sequentially."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time

base = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
executable = base / ".python/cpython-3.12.12-windows-x86_64-none/python.exe"
script = base / "audit/standalone_frame_churn.py"
results = []
for number, mode in enumerate(["timed", "timed", "control"], 1):
    state = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="pure-frame-", dir=base / ".t"))
    env = dict(os.environ)
    for name in list(env):
        if re.search(r"^(?:PYTHON|MAVERICK_|LIGHTWORK_|AWS_|AZURE_|OPENAI_|ANTHROPIC_|GOOGLE_|GCP_|HF_|EMAIL_|PG)|(?:API_KEY|TOKEN|SECRET|PASSWORD|DSN|CREDENTIAL)", name, re.I):
            env.pop(name)
    env.update({"TEMP": str(state), "TMP": str(state), "HOME": str(state), "USERPROFILE": str(state)})
    command = [str(executable), "-I", "-S", "-X", "faulthandler", str(script), mode]
    log = base / "audit" / ("standalone-frame-churn-" + str(number) + "-" + mode + ".log")
    started = time.monotonic()
    timed_out = False
    with log.open("wb") as output:
        try:
            run = subprocess.run(command, env=env, cwd=state, stdout=output,
                                 stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=30,
                                 creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
            code = run.returncode
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            timed_out, code = True, None
    entry = {"mode": mode, "command": command, "returncode": code,
             "returncode_hex": hex(code & 0xffffffff) if code is not None else None,
             "timeout_seconds": 30, "timed_out": timed_out,
             "elapsed_seconds": round(time.monotonic() - started, 3),
             "log": str(log.relative_to(base)), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    results.append(entry)
    print(json.dumps(entry), flush=True)
receipt = {"source": "stdlib-only; no Lightwork or ctypes imports", "attempts": results,
           "runtime": str(executable), "script_sha256": hashlib.sha256(script.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
           "upstream_context": ["https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/140815",
                                "https://github.com/python/cpython/pull/140921",
                                "https://github.com/python/cpython/issues/158200"]}
(base / "audit/standalone-frame-churn-results.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
